rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose way to say that nobody provided help.

example.english: I moved all the boxes unassisted.
example.traditional: 冇人幫手，我一個人搬晒啲箱。
example.jyutping: mou5 jan4 bong1 sau2 ngo5 jat1 go3 jan4 bun1 saai3 di1 soeng1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on doing something through one's own ability or resources rather than relying on help.

example.english: I opened this shop entirely unassisted.
example.traditional: 呢間舖頭係我靠自己一手一腳開返嚟嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 pou3 tau2 hai6 ngo5 kaau3 zi6 gei2 jat1 sau2 jat1 goek3 hoi1 faan1 lai4 ge3
